capability_bands.typical_output: Weighted assessment, decision contract, risk register, progress update, fail-closed checks.
10-15 changed files, about 500-600 added lines, dedicated workflow, machine-readable contracts, and focused failure tests.

capability_bands.observed_range: 44 minutes sequential stage time in the observed sample
capability_bands.typical_output: 8 internal artifacts, double-build determinism, multi-dimensional comparison, acceptance, evaluation, and full regression CI.

limitations: Only four directly comparable recent stages are used.
Repository line counts understate minified JSON size and do not measure conceptual difficulty.
Future unfamiliar integrations or external-human reviews may take materially longer.
level_assessment.plain_language: A bounded governance-heavy module has been completed about every 24 minutes at the median stage-to-stage cadence, while the observed full multi-artifact reproduction stage completed in under 44 minutes.
level_assessment.why_it_matters: The speed includes evidence binding, tests, CI, explicit authority boundaries, rollback, and documentation rather than code generation alone.

measurement_policy.claim_boundary: Observed internal session baseline, not an SLA or guarantee.
not_measured: model compute time separated from tool time
measurement_policy.pr_gate_latency: GitHub pull-request created_at to merged_at; includes CI/review/merge after the PR was opened.
measurement_policy.sequential_stage_elapsed: Previous bounded-stage merge to current bounded-stage merge; includes conversation, design, implementation, CI, and idle inside the observed sequence.
